game.romname: Destroy All Humans! Path of the Furon (USA)
game.name: Destroy All Humans! Path of the Furon (Europe)
game.desc: Destroy All Humans! Path of the Furon is the first game in the series to be released on Xbox 360. You play as Crypto, a small, temperamental and destructive alien, who tries to build a business on Earth while feeding his bosses human brains. But soon, Crypto must face mysterious enemies ready to do battle with him. New weapons and new techniques are on the agenda to help the little monster in his fight against the invader.
